segments.speaker: Speaker 1
segments.text: I suggest sending an email digest every morning. This is only an idea; we have not approved it.

segments.speaker: You
segments.text: I oppose adding email now because the app must work locally. Let us decide only the export format today.

segments.speaker: Speaker 1
segments.text: For export I propose Markdown, rather than PDF.

segments.speaker: You
segments.text: Markdown is agreed for this release. We will revisit email later, without making a commitment.

segments.speaker: Speaker 1
segments.text: Yes, Markdown is our decision. Nobody is assigned to implement export yet.
